ios.desc:
• Libbo leverage the power of the web to bring you a huge library of books to help organizing your collections.
• Remember in which format you own each book. It’s increasingly common to feature a mixing library of ebooks, audiobooks and good ol’ prints!
• Books are easily categorized using an intuitive and modern UI. Shelves are automatically created based on your selections.
• Never forget which books to recommend when friends are asking, Libbo makes it easy.
• Keep track of your wishlist and conveniently access more info about them on the web instantly.

quotes.text:
If you are looking for book collection apps, I started using Libbo not long ago, pretty smooth!
